papers.title: Enhancing Fatigue Strength of Selective Laser Melting‐Fabricated Inconel 718 by Tailoring Heat Treatment Route
papers.abstract: Voids are always unavoidably introduced into metals fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM), and thus greatly degrade fatigue performance of metals. Such a fatal weakness strongly limits the application of SLM‐fabricated metals to load‐bearing structural components for the long‐term service. Here, the authors found that fatigue strength of SLM‐fabricated Inconel 718 is significantly improved after the proper heat treatment route not only due to the elimination of Laves phases and the precipitation of γ″/γ′ strengthening phases, but also the appearance of ultrafine‐scale acicular δ phases, which effectively suppressed the degraded effect of voids. The finding may provide a potential strategy to enhance fatigue strength of SLM‐fabricated materials by tailoring heat‐treatment route.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于航空航天用Inconel 718的疲劳性能，不涉及生物医用材料、多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration; it focuses on non-biocompatible Inconel 718 for aerospace applications.

summary_zh.motivation: SLM制备金属的疲劳性能因气孔而严重下降
summary_zh.method: 通过不同热处理路线优化γ″/γ′相和δ相析出
summary_zh.result: 适当热处理显著提高疲劳强度，抑制气孔的有害效应
summary_zh.validation: 进行疲劳测试验证热处理效果

summary_en.motivation: The presence of voids in SLM-fabricated metals severely degrades fatigue performance, limiting their use in load-bearing components.
summary_en.method: Different heat treatment routes were applied to SLM-fabricated Inconel 718 to tailor precipitation of γ″/γ′ strengthening phases and acicular δ phases.
summary_en.result: Optimal heat treatment significantly improved fatigue strength by mitigating the detrimental effect of voids.
summary_en.validation: Fatigue tests were conducted to evaluate the improvement under different heat treatment conditions.

papers.title: Non-Intrusive Computational Method and Uncertainty Quantification for isolator operability calculations

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注推进系统中的隔离器可操作性计算，与生物力学或植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on propulsion system isolator operability, with no biomedical context, implant mechanics, or FEA surrogate modeling for biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高隔离器可操作性计算的效率与可靠性
summary_zh.method: 采用非侵入式计算方法和不确定性量化
summary_zh.result: 实现了对隔离器操作边界的有效预测
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真案例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and reliability of isolator operability calculations in propulsion systems.
summary_en.method: A non-intrusive computational method combined with uncertainty quantification is employed.
summary_en.result: Effective prediction of isolator operating boundaries is achieved.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through simulation case studies.

llm.why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no FEA surrogate, no biomedical context, and no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.method: 综述不确定性量化方法在动态系统中的应用。
summary_zh.result: 总结了现有方法的优缺点及未来方向。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为综述性论文。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenges of uncertainty quantification in combustion-related dynamic systems.
summary_en.method: A review of uncertainty quantification approaches applied to dynamic systems with combustion applications.
summary_en.result: Summarizes the strengths, weaknesses, and future directions of existing methods.
